text:
Error tracking is in place, using the team's self-hosted GlitchTip. I installed the dependencies, checked that `server.js` parses and confirmed that `setupExpressErrorHandler` exists. I haven't run the server or sent a test error to GlitchTip.

I picked GlitchTip because GBrain has a note that the team self-hosts it at `errors.larkfield.example`. It also records that Sentry was rejected on 2026-10-28 over event-volume cost. GlitchTip accepts the Sentry SDK, so I used `@sentry/node`. That package isn't the hosted Sentry service.

- **`src/instrument.js`** (new): initializes the SDK from `GLITCHTIP_DSN`. If the variable isn't set, tracking is off, so local development and tests are unaffected. Performance tracing is turned off.
- **`src/server.js`**: imports `instrument.js` first and adds the Sentry Express error handler after the routes. Express 5 passes errors from async handlers to it, so a failing database query in `/households/:id/lists` gets reported. I also added a fallback handler that returns a JSON 500.
- **`package.json`**: added `@sentry/node`.

To turn it on, set `GLITCHTIP_DSN` in the deployed environment. I didn't change CI, and the Node 22.11 pin is untouched.
